DOC-NAMEPFX-005.text: Registration wala naam hi OTR aur har application mein read-only jaata hai; admit card par naam kaise chhapega, yeh manual mein nahi likha. Document verification mein kya accept hoga, ye Aayog decide karta hai — portal manual mein iska niyam nahi hai, isliye main guarantee nahi de sakta.
DOC-NAMEPFX-005.fact: The registered name is carried read-only into the OTR and every application (F-OTR-02)

DOC-NAMEPFX-005.text: DV mein kya accept hoga aur admit card par naam kaise chhapega, yeh dono baatein manual mein nahi hain, isliye main andaza nahi lagaunga. Main dono sawaal confirmation ke liye aage bhej raha hoon.
DOC-NAMEPFX-005.fact: The manual does not say anything else about how the name is printed or checked. Not in the flow: whether a prefix/surname difference will be accepted at document verification or counselling

REG-MULTI-002.text: Primary aur Upper Primary ke alag application hote hain, aur har exam ka application aur fee alag hota hai. Dono bharne ki anumati hai ya nahi, yeh hamare official source mein saaf nahi hai.
REG-MULTI-002.fact: Special TET Primary and Upper Primary are separate applications

REG-APPLY-002.text: OTR yaani One Time Registration, matlab ek baar ka panjikaran, jismein poti ki saari details ek hi baar bharni hoti hain. Phir wahi details har exam ke form mein apne aap aa jaati hain.
REG-APPLY-002.fact: details are entered once in the OTR and carried into every exam application

ELG-NET-003.text: Doosre rajya ka SET maanya hai ya nahi, yeh rules mein spasht nahi hai, isliye main aapki query Aayog ko escalate kar raha hoon. Aap General maani jaayengi, isliye fee bhi General wali lagegi.
ELG-NET-003.fact: without stating whether a SET conducted by another state is accepted, and does not mention ICAR/ASRB NET – HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED; the AI must not confirm or deny. Non-UP candidates are treated as General/unreserved for reservation and fee (F-OTR-P6)

DOC-MARK-001.text: Ji haan, teeno saal ki marksheet ek hi PDF mein jod sakte hain, bas poori file 20 se 200 KB ke andar honi chahiye.
DOC-MARK-001.fact: if they combine several pages into one PDF it must still be within 20–200 KB

ELG-APPR-003.text: Rule ke hisaab se NET ya PhD last date tak hona chahiye; agar result ya award uske baad aata hai, to yeh shart poori nahi hoti.
ELG-APPR-003.fact: so a NET result or PhD award expected after the last date does not meet this rule

ELG-APPR-003.text: Agar PhD award last date ke baad milta hai, to Assistant Professor ke rule ki shart poori nahi hoti, kyunki qualification last date tak honi chahiye.
ELG-APPR-003.fact: candidates must hold the qualification by the final date of application (F-AP-03); so a NET result or PhD award expected after the last date does not meet this rule

DOC-PWD-001.text: OTR mein PwD ke liye kam se kam 40% disability chahiye, to 40% ya usse zyada wala certificate is shart ko poora karta hai.
DOC-PWD-001.fact: In the OTR, PwD = Yes asks Disability Type, Percentage (minimum 40%)

DOC-CERTNO-001.text: OTR baad mein bhi edit ho sakta hai, isliye official instruction aane par yeh number theek kiya ja sakta hai; bas tab tak application lock mat kariye.
DOC-CERTNO-001.fact: Advise the candidate not to lock any exam application on a guessed value (locking is permanent for Special TET, F-STET-10); the OTR itself stays editable, so the value can be updated later once guidance is received (F-OTR-03).

REG-OTRID-002.text: Iske liye koi intezaar nahi hai – login karte hi OTR ID aapke Dashboard par hi dikh jaati hai.
REG-OTRID-002.fact: the OTR ID is displayed on the Dashboard One-Time Registration panel (F-OTR-05)

DOC-SIGN-001.text: Aapki signature file 100 KB se badi hai; ise 10 se 100 KB ke beech save karke dobara upload kijiye.
DOC-SIGN-001.fact: OTR Documents page: Signature must be JPG or PNG, 10–100 KB (F-OTR-D1).

REG-NEWREG-001.text: OTR matlab ek baar ka registration – isme details ek hi baar bharni hoti hain, phir wahi details har exam ke form mein kaam aati hain.
REG-NEWREG-001.fact: (1) Candidate Registration creates the account, (2) the OTR profile stores reusable details

ELG-PWD-005.text: Ji, apna OTR ID bata dijiye; scribe aur ghoshna dono sawaal main senior team ko bhej raha hoon.
ELG-PWD-005.fact: who may act as scribe (e.g. a minor), extra time

REG-LOGIN-001.text: Login theek karne ka koi official tareeka manual mein nahi hai, isliye main aapka case technical team ko escalate kar raha hoon.
REG-LOGIN-001.fact: capture details and escalate to the Technical Team. No recovery path is documented (F-LOG-02).

REG-CORR-004.text: Assistant Professor mein final submit ke baad DOB locked rehti hai; correction mein theek hogi ya nahi, yeh Aayog tay karega, isliye main vaada nahi kar sakta. Main isko Aayog ke liye escalate kar raha hoon.
REG-CORR-004.fact: for Assistant Professor, category, sub-category, DOB and gender are locked after final submit (F-AP-02) and correction is allowed till the Commission-fixed date (F-AP-04)

REG-MULTI-003.text: PGT mein do subject aur dono exam ek hi din padne par kya hoga, yeh dono baatein hamare source mein nahi hain. Main dono sawaal Aayog ke liye darj kar raha hoon.
REG-MULTI-003.fact: PGT in two subjects, and exam-date clashes, are not covered in the sources

DOC-SIZE-002.text: Aapki photo 100 KB ki limit se badi hai, isliye upload nahi ho rahi. OTR Documents page par photo aur signature dono JPG ya PNG, 10 se 100 KB ke hone chahiye.
DOC-SIZE-002.fact: Photo aur signature wahan 10 se 100 KB JPG/PNG hain.
